services.name: The Downwinder
services.desc: Rate $45 per person for all daytime tours $55 per person for the sunset tour Duration 1.5 Hours About - Come out and enjoy those summer breezes on a kayak or paddle board with our Original "Downwinder". We will take you up to 2 1/2 miles upwind by boat through the protected Corolla Marsh Estuary, then you get to enjoy the trip back at your own pace with the wind at your back. This tour has become a fast favorite of every group that has tried it. You can chose between single or double kayaks, with no experience necessary. services.name: Half Hour Wave Runner Rental
services.desc: Speed across the beautiful Currituck Sound on our brand new 4 strokes wave runners! You can speed across the warm, calm waters of the Currituck Sound and enjoy breathtaking views of the Currituck Lighthouse and historic Whalehead Club. We stock all Brand New First Class Yamaha 4-stroke Waverunners that can hold up to three people. We have the shortest distance to our riding area on the Outer Banks, to make switching riders and family members fast and easy. We have the largest riding area to ensure all drivers have space for safety and plenty of room to have fun! Rates Wave Runner: $89 Important Information Up to 3 people per waverunner Must be 18 to rent, 16 with proof of age to drive

Our awesome 90 min Corolla Waverunner Tour embarks from our location in Timbuck II in the center of Corolla. Depending on the weather conditions, we will then head out to see and explore up and down the Corolla sound side on our new, comfortable, and fast yamaha waverunners.
